stubs.how: static.rust-lang.org and crates.io are unreachable in this sandbox, so the core cannot be compiled; out/aladin.js is the project's own published build of this exact version (npm aladin-lite@3.9.0-beta, published 2026-06-01, same day as commit 60c5cf4), which embeds the compiled WASM. Unmodified.

stub/hips-registry.mjs: ~47 image HiPS records (DSS, 2MASS, AllWISE, Pan-STARRS, SDSS, GALEX, Fermi, eROSITA, Planck, Mars, Moon...) + 10 catalogue HiPS, filtered by ID wildcard / expr / stc / fields like the real service; feeds the HiPS browser and ID resolution

stubs.service: HiPS tile servers (alasky DSS2 color, Pan-STARRS DR1 color)
stubs.how: served from the real HiPS samples shipped in the repo (examples/data/hips copied to out/hips): DSS2 colour around Orion's belt (Allsky + deep tiles), Pan-STARRS, CFHT and JWST Stephan's Quintet. These samples are cutouts (the DSS2 Allsky has real pixels in only 1 of 768 cells), so any tile missing on disk is rebuilt on the fly by stub/tiles.mjs (jimp) from its nearest real ancestor tile or the Allsky mosaic; HiPS servers never answer 404. Outside the cutouts the rebuilt tiles are black because the samples hold no data there. Surveys in the registry without any local sample still 404 if selected.
DSS2 and Pan-STARRS previews served from the local HiPS preview.jpg; others 404
stub/objects.mjs: ~90 well-known objects with real J2000 coordinates and aliases (M 31, Horsehead, Orion Nebula, Stephan's Quintet, Sgr A*...), answered in Sesame text format

stubs.service: SIMBAD pointer (simbad-quick.py) and SIMBAD cone search (simbad.cds.unistra.fr/cone)
stubs.how: stub/catalogs.mjs: nearest known object for the pointer; cone search returns a VOTable with the known objects in the cone plus deterministic, position-seeded field sources (Gaia DR3 / TYC / 2MASS / HD / LEDA identifiers, object types, V mags)
stub/catalogs.mjs: deterministic Gaia DR3-like (Source, RA_ICRS, DE_ICRS, Plx, pm, Gmag, BP-RP, RV, Teff) or 2MASS PSC-like VOTables for the requested cone
unwraps the url= parameter and routes it through the same stubs

notes: Aladin Lite is a JS/WASM sky-viewer library; the app is shown as the full-window viewer (out/index.html, same options as examples/index.html: fullscreen, layers/settings/goto/projection/share/simbad-pointer/grid controls, context menu). Run .ui-capture/start.sh (node server.mjs, PORT=4483) which serves out/ and the stubs. Node 20.18.1 pinned in mise.toml; .ui-capture/package.json + node_modules (jimp 1.6.0, already installed) used by the tile filler. Data: the saved session of an observer working on an Orion B / L1630 young-stellar-object programme, restored on load by out/session.js through Aladin Lite's public API (generated by .ui-capture/gen-session.mjs into out/session/): base DSS2 colour at Orion's belt (Flame Nebula, Horsehead/IC 434, sigma Ori); image stack with a hidden Pan-STARRS comparison layer and the user's own CFHT and JWST Stephan's Quintet HiPS; catalogues SIMBAD (cone 1.6 deg, ~350 rows), VizieR Gaia DR3 (cone 0.2 deg), the user's VOTable 'OriB YSO candidates v7' (210 rows with class, photometry, status confirmed/candidate/rejected/follow-up, last-observed dates 2025-2026, free-text comments) and 'My notes' markers (12 annotated popups); graphic overlays of 46 instrument footprints (VLT/MUSE, VLT/KMOS, JWST/NIRCam, CFHT/WIRCam; executed vs planned drawn fainter); a MOC for KMOS 2026B coverage. Main areas: sky view, left toolbar (layer stack / settings / go-to / projection / share), HiPS browser (via layers > browse, fed by the MocServer stub), catalogue measurement table (click a source), SIMBAD pointer, coordinate frame selector, zoom controls. Tools for checking: tools/check.sh takes a headless Chromium screenshot (single-process mode) into shots/. Sky imagery exists only around the Orion belt target (and Stephan's Quintet for the CFHT/JWST layers); panning far away shows black sky.
